plans.objective: Reconstruct E_B and E_F so developer test test_dup_mul_poly fails on buggy and passes on fixed by switching the build/runtime environment to avoid native-library numerical failure in RR polynomial multiplication (avoid Karatsuba via correct build of sympy core).
assumptions: The failing developer test sympy/polys/tests/test_densearith.py::test_dup_mul_poly exercises dense polynomial multiplication in the RR domain and is sensitive to the same numerical instability described in issue #27503/#27484.

The buggy vs fixed revisions differ only in E_B/E_F (environment/build) while T_dev is identical, and we can flip the failure by rebuilding one or both revisions with different native build configuration (e.g., disable use of specific optimized libraries/flags) without editing test code.

A native/library/build configuration change can alter the RR-domain multiplication result enough to cross the test tolerance gate for F2P; i.e., the current fixed build is correct but the buggy build is incorrect due to build-time configuration selecting an unstable numerical path.
